residual_findings.title: apps/web has no tests at the most architectural surface (NexusClient adapter, theme/provider, error parsing) — scaffold ships without a test baseline
residual_findings.note: P2 (screens) is the natural place to establish the apps/web test baseline (vitest + testing-library + msw for BrowserClient). Adapter + error-parsing tests should land with the screens that exercise them.
residual_findings.closure_note: apps/web architectural-surface test baseline established in V1.65 P1 (feature/v1.65-web-test-baseline): NexusClient adapter-contract guard + transport coverage (T1), ThemeProvider light/dark (T2), toast hook + error-envelope path (T3), msw handlers registry (T4), v8 coverage config (T5). 30 -> 62 vitest tests, all green; 94.57% statement / 96.77% branch coverage on the architectural surface, every file >= 80%. Closed ahead of the original P2 target so the outline editor builds on a tested scaffold.
